Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
Relevant text :

[obf] Only usable by a ready, untapped vampire other than the acting minion
you control. The acting minion gets +1 stealth. Only one Veil the Legions
may be played each action. [OBF] As above, and this vampire may burn X
additional blood to give +1 stealth to the next X actions your minions
perform this turn. Only one Veil the Legions can be played at superior each
turn.

I'd like to know what are the "next X actions" when DI or DT are involved :

I pay enough blood to Veil 3 actions. I do 2.

- the third one is a political action, and is delayed ; do I get +1 stealth
on the replacement action that my minion will attempt ?

- same question if the action is Directed instead of delayed (funny, I put a
capital D on Directed, not delayed, wonder why...)

T.I.A.
--------
OMMV but IANLSJ

Orpheus

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Orpheus wrote:
> Relevant text :
>
> [obf] Only usable by a ready, untapped vampire other than the acting minion
> you control. The acting minion gets +1 stealth. Only one Veil the Legions
> may be played each action. [OBF] As above, and this vampire may burn X
> additional blood to give +1 stealth to the next X actions your minions
> perform this turn. Only one Veil the Legions can be played at superior each
> turn.
>
> I'd like to know what are the "next X actions" when DI or DT are involved :
>
> I pay enough blood to Veil 3 actions. I do 2.
>
> - the third one is a political action, and is delayed ; do I get +1 stealth
> on the replacement action that my minion will attempt ?

No. The action existed. It even reached resolution.

> - same question if the action is Directed instead of delayed (funny, I put a
> capital D on Directed, not delayed, wonder why...)

Yes. The action card is canceled (not the action). Canceling the action card
means the action is never begun. The action never exists.

Messages.Author: François
Messages.Body:


If that third action was cancelled before resolution, with Tangle
Atropos' Hand for example, would the next one be at +1 stealth ?

If that third action was cancelled after resolution (using Red Herring
or Krassimir's ability), would the next one be at +1 stealth ?

Thank you,

Francois
